pkgmetadata.longdescription:
goose is an open-source, extensible AI agent from Block (Square) that runs locally and can execute, edit and test code on its own, using any LLM. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to extend its capabilities with external tools and services.
This package installs the prebuilt glibc CLI binary only. It does not package the -vulkan or -musl CLI variants, nor the separate Goose Desktop application.
